style: Photorealistic cinematic image, vertical 2:3 portrait. Dramatic lighting, film grain, shallow depth of field. Subject in the upper 55% of the frame; the bottom 40% must be darker and visually calm (white text will be placed there). Absolutely NO text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks. No real celebrities. No nudity.
